meta.label: TCN (dilated causal 1-D CNN)

compute.eval_note: harness evaluate.py per rung (800 sim val runs + 52 dev basins) not included: about 0.5-4 CPU-min per rung
compute.notes: 3 rungs; one thread (torch.set_num_threads(1)), time.process_time() of the training process, shared 2-core machine

meta.feature_engineering: None beyond the shared arms_seq pipeline (common/seqlib.py), identical for all four sequence arms: FlowCast's 11 scaled daily features (P/10, log1p P, PET/5, T_mean/T_min/T_max /10, SRAD/150, vp/1000, wind/3, sin/cos day of year) + FlowCast's 18-value static vector (batch["static"], standardised with the train bank mean/sd) repeated every day; target in units of the basin mean precipitation exp(static[11]); 730-day windows (365 warm-up + 365 target), inference in 365-day blocks each with its own 365-day warm-up (FlowCast). Causal: day t uses forcing up to day t only.
